statement: Max buys 2 pencils that cost 5 cents each and 1 eraser that costs 3 cents. How much does he spend?

choices.misconception: I paid for only one pencil and the eraser.
I added up the two pencils and forgot the eraser.
I thought all three things cost 5 cents each.
I paid for 2 erasers as well as 2 pencils.

hints: How much do the two pencils cost together?
Find the cost of each kind of thing first, counting how many of it Max buys. Then add the costs of all the things together.
Two pencils cost 5 + 5 = 10 cents. Now add the 3 cents for the eraser.

solutions.reliable: Two pencils cost 5 + 5 = 10 cents and the eraser costs 3 cents, so Max spends 10 + 3 = 13 cents. The idea to keep: count how many of each thing is bought before adding the prices.

whyOnTest: Money questions with two kinds of item check that a student uses each price the right number of times.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
